## Summary

The usage ledger now lives at `~/.smysl/usage.log` (or `%USERPROFILE%` on Windows) instead of `<project>/.smysl/usage.log`, so `ingest`/`usage`/`--reset` track cost across every checkout on the machine rather than resetting per project.

Changes:
- `crates/smysl-provider/src/usage.rs`: added `Ledger::home_path()` (with a pure, testable `Ledger::under()` helper) and a small `home_dir()` resolver; added unit tests.
- `src/main.rs`: `cmd_ingest` and `cmd_usage` now open the ledger via `Ledger::home_path()` instead of resolving it against the project root.
- `tests/dispatch.rs`: each dispatched command now runs with `HOME` pointed at its own scratch directory, so the test suite never touches a real developer's home ledger.
- `tests/cmd_usage.rs` (new): verifies the ledger is written under `$HOME` and not the project dir, that entries recorded from one project are visible from another with the same `$HOME`, and that `--reset` clears the shared ledger.
- Updated the manual chapter and changelog to describe the new location.

Both required suites pass: `cargo test -q -p smysl --tests --no-fail-fast` and `cargo test -q -p smysl-core --no-fail-fast`, plus verified `--all-features`/`--no-default-features` builds and the manual's doc-output replay (0 mismatches). No commit was made, per your instructions.
